```python
def priority(f):
    p = f['progress']
    s = f['spread']
    rw = 0.10 + 0.25*p + 0.25*p*p
    rel = s / (0.4 + s + 1e-9)
    rgw = (0.05 + 0.18*p) * (0.35 + 0.65*rel)
    cdw = 0.04 + 0.10*p
    return -f['distance'] + rw*f['return_distance'] + rgw*f['regret'] + cdw*f['cluster_density'] + 0.04*f['nearest_remaining']
```
